$description: Rhythm / position rules. Each rule id is implemented in schema/semantic_validate.py (verify_all.py checks both directions).

rules.rule: Exactly one HERO-category node per page.
The first in-flow non-SHELL node is the HERO.
shell.header is the first SHELL node and precedes all in-flow content.
Two adjacent in-flow nodes may not share a category.

exceptions.why: about page has two consecutive story blocks (AboutHero.html about-story-section x2)
every case study has Context + Solution back to back
case-study media run: any order, any adjacency (measured item sequences in extraction/measured-values.json)

rules.rule: A RUNTIME node with constraints.attachTo must appear on a page that contains its host section.
At most one pinned scroll stage (pattern pinned-char-wave) per page.

At most 3 distinct scroll-scrub / pin-scrub motion patterns per page (home: pinned-char-wave, scrubbed-path-draw, footer-logo-stretch; about: story-path-scrub, stacked-card-scrub, footer-logo-stretch).
At most one CTA-category node per page.
